text: I think it mostly comes down to time and habits. Many people work long hours, so they grab fast food instead of cooking, and they're too tired to exercise afterwards. Also, unhealthy food is often cheaper and easier to find. Once a bad routine is established, it's quite hard to break. That's why small changes, like walking to work, tend to be more realistic than a total lifestyle overhaul.

tips.en: A colloquial phrase describes eating on the run precisely.
tips.kk: Ауызекі идиома асығыс тамақтану әдетін дәл сипаттайды.
tips.ru: Разговорная идиома точно описывает привычку питаться на бегу.
tips.example: grab fast food instead of cooking

tips.en: A 'Once' clause with a passive shows control of complex grammar.
tips.kk: «Once» және ырықсыз етісті бағыныңқы сөйлем күрделі грамматиканы көрсетеді.
tips.ru: Придаточное с «Once» и пассивом показывает владение сложной грамматикой.
tips.example: Once a bad routine is established, it's quite hard to break

note.en: to buy and eat fast food quickly

questions.question: Why do some people find it difficult to stay healthy?

text: I'd say so, because healthy citizens cost the country less in the long run. Governments could build free sports facilities or offer discounts on gym memberships, for instance. Some countries even tax sugary drinks, which has worked quite well. Having said that, I don't think people should be forced, since that might make them resent exercise. Encouragement is probably more effective than pressure.

tips.en: 'Having said that' softens the position and shows a balanced view.
tips.kk: «Having said that» ұстанымды жұмсартып, салмақты көзқарасты көрсетеді.
tips.ru: «Having said that» смягчает позицию и показывает взвешенный взгляд.
tips.example: Having said that, I don't think people should be forced

tips.en: Specific measures (facilities, discounts) make the answer concrete.
tips.kk: Нақты шаралар (спорт орындары, жеңілдіктер) жауапты мазмұнды етеді.
tips.ru: Конкретные меры (спортзалы, скидки) делают ответ предметным.
tips.example: Governments could build free sports facilities or offer discounts on gym memberships, for instance

questions.question: Should the government do more to encourage people to exercise?

text: Absolutely, and in some ways it's even more overlooked. You can see a broken arm, but stress or anxiety is invisible, so people tend to ignore it. In my country, many people still feel embarrassed to talk about it. I think that's slowly changing, partly because celebrities are speaking openly about their experiences. Hopefully, that will encourage ordinary people to ask for help earlier.

tips.en: Comparing visible and invisible makes the argument vivid.
tips.kk: Көрінетін және көрінбейтін нәрсенің салыстыруы дәлелді көрнекі етеді.
tips.ru: Сравнение видимого и невидимого делает аргумент наглядным.
tips.example: You can see a broken arm, but stress or anxiety is invisible

tips.en: 'partly because' names the reason for the change precisely.
tips.example: partly because celebrities are speaking openly about their experiences

questions.followUp: Do people talk about it enough?
questions.question: Is mental health as important as physical health?

text: People eat a lot more processed food than before, mainly because life has become faster. Supermarkets are full of ready meals, and delivery apps make it effortless to order takeaway. On the other hand, there's growing awareness of healthy eating, so organic and plant-based options are more popular now. I'd say it's a mixed picture, with some people eating far better and others far worse than their grandparents did.

tips.en: 'On the other hand' brings in the opposite trend.
tips.kk: «On the other hand» қарама-қарсы үрдісті енгізеді.
tips.ru: «On the other hand» вводит противоположную тенденцию.
tips.example: On the other hand, there's growing awareness of healthy eating

tips.en: The summary 'a mixed picture' avoids being absolute.
tips.example: I'd say it's a mixed picture

note.en: neither all good nor all bad
more and more people know about it
